stateTransition.evidence: The Devpost submit-project receipt returned submission 1158722 with status Submitted, authenticated readback returned the same non-null submittedAt value, and a later anonymous page readback exposed the current hotel title and uploaded hotel image in Open Graph metadata.

invariants: A version 11 update receipt and authenticated content readback prove a saved public description, not final challenge submission.
Only a non-null Devpost submittedAt value proves final WebMCP Challenge submission; null keeps that claim unproven.
Anonymous public HTML and the authenticated project readback remain separate time-stamped observations.
An exact uploaded-image URL in the project Open Graph metadata proves public project association only at that observation time.
The anonymous Open Graph title is recorded separately from the visible document title and heading.
The retry counts describe a fictional device-local demonstration, not a real hotel reservation.

updateReceipt.evidenceBoundary: The receipt proves the accepted update version. The authenticated readback separately proves the resulting project fields.

project.name: Kyoto Booking Retry Proof
project.tagline: WebMCP stops a lost hotel-booking response from becoming a duplicate reservation.

authenticatedReadback.evidenceBoundary: The authenticated readback reports the project content and non-null submittedAt value without retaining credentials, cookies, tokens, headers, or account details.

title.evidenceBoundary: The fresh anonymous HTML contained the same hotel name in the document title, visible heading, and og:title.

anonymousPublicHtml.evidenceBoundary: This anonymous readback proves the returned public HTML, visible markers, current Open Graph title, and exact uploaded-image reference only at the stated observation time.

projectAssociation.reason: The asset URL returned HTTP 200 and the fresh anonymous project HTML referenced the exact URL as og:image.

submissionReceipt.evidenceBoundary: This records the Devpost submit-project result and is verified by a later authenticated project readback with the same non-null submittedAt value.
